noise_assumptions.notes: Reported assumptions for design context only. The official Task B uses QFF2026-v2 unchanged.

design_rationale: Our PS-Q2 kernel circuit is a 6-qubit ZZ fidelity circuit whose RZZ entanglers (CX-RZ-CX) act on a logical ring, 24 CX in total. The 2x3 grid contains a 6-cycle (physical 1-0-3-4-5-2), so the ring is placed with zero SWAPs at 24 CX and depth 41, the same as all-to-all, while a linear chain needs 46 CX and a star 36. The extra rung (1-4) shortens routing for the 3-qubit QFT, giving QFT-3 depth 21 and noisy fidelity 0.627 versus 0.604 for ring, linear and star; one SWAP remains because a grid has no triangles. All links are two-way because the benchmark enforces direction: with one-way links the same grid raises QFT-3 depth from 21 to 31 (fidelity 0.585) and our kernel circuit depth from 41 to 51. The native gates rx, ry, rz and cx are the organizer's fully-noised basis, so every compiled gate carries QFF2026-v2 noise. The trade-off is 7 couplers (14 directed edges) instead of a 6-link ring: they add hardware cost and no benefit for our ring circuit, but buy the cheaper QFT routing.
